muc.title: The tech talks, the customer is lost
muc.text: Customers get lost when the tech says the power IC is broken. AI helps phone repair shops explain faults more simply.

muc.title: Use everyday examples
muc.text: Type the fault in technician terms into a chatbot and ask it to explain with an everyday example.

muc.title: A clear quote template
muc.text: Ask AI for a quote template with parts, labor, repair time and warranty, so customers feel at ease.

muc.title: Keep customers' phones private
muc.text: Remind customers to back up before the repair, and never paste their passwords or photos into AI.

muc.title: A fault sheet for the counter
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for short explanations of the three most common faults, then print them for the counter.
